C’est mon 2eme achat, après avoir reçu le premier au mois d’août passé. Ravie de la qualité et du rendu, super beau et très réaliste, Excellent rapport qualité/prix. Satisfaite de la réactivité et des délais de livraison! Je recommande fortement

I’m really happy with this faux olive tree. It looks much more realistic than I expected for the price, and the 6-foot height is perfect for filling an empty corner without overwhelming the room. The leaves have a nice natural look and it was easy to set up. I also like that it has a weighted base/anti-tip design, which makes it feel more secure.

Pros: easy to assemble. Branches are adjustable to create the fullness you desire. Good weight. Nice color of leaves. Realistic looking tree bark. Cons: the way the branches are attached to trunk looks fake. Skinny branch/wires looks obvious. From far away it’s not noticeable so I guess where you place it would matter. You really need to fluff the leaves around to hide the attachment to branches. Would I buy again? Yes. 8/10 overall.

Bellissimo albero di eucalipto artificiale! Aggiunge un tocco naturale ed elegante alla casa. Le dimensioni sono perfette, è facile da sistemare e non richiede manutenzione. Sono molto soddisfatta del mio acquisto. Lo consiglio!
